mapper.select: /** com.khnp.pels.api.TstEventSelectList */ SELECT T1.EVENT_TYP, T1.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL, T1.PAGE_NO, T1.PDF_PAGE_NO, T1.STROKE_SEQ, T2.STROKE_COLOR, T2.STROKE_WIDTH, T1.USER_ID, TO_CHAR(T1.EVENT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3') AS EVENT_DT FROM GE_MP_CHECK_EVENT_M T1 JOIN GE_MP_CHECK_EVENT_STRK_S T2 ON T1.EVENT_SEQ = T2.EVENT_SEQ WHERE T1.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{value} ORDER BY T1.EVENT_DT , T1.EVENT_SEQ
